acceptance_tests: D1: keep the implementation independent (no import of flash-13 module, no shared helper)
D2: on a copy of the shared fixture corpus report per-fixture x per-implementation accept/reject + rule ids
D3: every disagreement reported as a finding with minimal repro; disagreements are the deliverable
D4: measure YOUR escape rate on the worker-06 semantic corpus when published; state it as a number with corpus hash
do_not_claim: No node completion, no theorem, no physics result. Report unverified; the schema owner (lead-formulation) binds interpretation. Write only under your own artifacts/<worker>/ path.
falsifier: Two independent implementations agree on a mutant that is in fact leaky (both false-negative) -> differential testing insufficient for that leak class; report the leak class and a targeted rule proposal.
revision_requirements: Your proposed canonical home verification/class_binding/ is lead-owned; keep code under artifacts/flash-11/ and report.
stop_rule: 3.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.
title: Second, independently written gate + differential agreement matrix (your linter is the base).
